services.name: Jet Skiing
services.desc: At North Beach Watersports we have the largest riding area in Corolla; approximately 1 mile long by ½ mile wide, large enough for any riding style from mild to wild! Our Yamaha Wave Runners are stable and easy to operate (no classes required), hold up to three people and are equipped with life jackets, kill switches, fire extinguishers and whistles for your safety. Our knowledgeable staff will guide you through the operation procedure and get you out on the water in minutes with complete confidence. Whether you prefer a leisurely cruise along the shoreline or an adrenaline-pumping dash through the waves, jet skiing offers something for everyone. You can switch out riders as much as you like

services.name: Pontoon Boats
services.desc: Renting a Pontoon is a great way to relax on the Currituck Sound. Our fleet of modern, well-maintained pontoon boats is designed to provide a smooth and enjoyable ride for all passengers. Equipped with plush seating and ample shade, you can cruise in style while soaking up the sun or enjoying a peaceful sunset. We offer 2-hour and 4-hour rentals. Our dock facility allows you to board the Pontoon Boat without getting into the water and is accessible. Experience the ultimate in relaxation and adventure, grab a fishing pole and head out to catch some dinner! We recommend wearing a bathing suit or whatever is most comfortable. Our dock is set up to allow dry entry on to and off of the pontoon

blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of water activities such as parasailing, jet skiing, kayaking, pontoon boat cruises, paddleboarding, and tubing. The company emphasizes safety with certified staff and updated equipment. The location is accessible and suitable for all experience levels.
